Save plot GPS coordinates of a trial already in Breedbase

Source: R/plot_coordinates.R
save_breedbase_coordinates.Rd

Sends the plot coordinates of a design (see add_plot_coordinates()) to a trial that is already saved in Breedbase, e.g. when the plots were measured after the trial was saved. Plots are matched by plot number, after checking that every plot has the same accession in Breedbase as in the design. Coordinates already stored for these plots are replaced. save_breedbase() does this by itself for a design that has coordinates.

Usage

save_breedbase_coordinates(
  design,
  con,
  trial_name = NULL,
  dry_run = FALSE,
  confirm = interactive()
)

Arguments

design

A design with coordinates, from add_plot_coordinates().

con

A connection from breedbase_login().

trial_name

The trial name in Breedbase. For a multi-location p-rep design, the location is added as in save_breedbase(). Can be omitted for a prepared Breedbase trial or a design with plot names.

dry_run

Logical. Check the trial and plots but write nothing.

confirm

Logical. Ask before writing (default in interactive sessions).

Value

Invisibly, a tibble with one row per trial: trial_name, plots_with_gps (sent) and gps_found (read back from Breedbase).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
con <- breedbase_login("https://cassavabase.org", "jdoe")
rc <- add_plot_coordinates(rc, origin = c(7.4931, 3.9035), plot_width = 3, plot_length = 5)
save_breedbase_coordinates(rc, con, trial_name = "AYT_2026_Ibadan")
} # }
